passage: The redesign will eliminate all errors. The task was finished. In this test, the second sample cooled faster: three minutes rather than five.

findings.diagnosis: The passage supplies no basis for predicting that every error will disappear.
findings.question: Which errors were tested, and what changed?
findings.think_first: Identify the tested error types and the evidence for a bounded claim.

suggestions.label: Name the tested scope
suggestions.text: In [the tested workflow], the redesign reduced [the measured error type] by [the observed amount].
suggestions.why: Use only verified values; this template exposes the evidence that is still needed.

suggestions.label: State the aim
suggestions.text: The redesign aims to reduce errors.
suggestions.why: Describes an intention without claiming that the outcome has been achieved.

findings.diagnosis: The agent is omitted. That matters only if this reader needs to know who finished the task.
findings.question: Does the actor matter here?
findings.think_first: Decide whether responsibility or information order makes the actor relevant.
findings.context_condition: Passes if completion is the point and the actor is known or irrelevant.

keep.why: The passive can keep attention on completion when the agent is irrelevant.

suggestions.label: Name responsibility
suggestions.text: [The responsible person or team] finished the task.
suggestions.why: Use the actual actor if responsibility matters; do not invent one.

findings.diagnosis: The comparison is bounded to one test, and the two durations are stated.
findings.question: Does the conclusion remain within the stated comparison?
findings.think_first: Keep the scope tied to this test rather than generalizing beyond it.

keep.why: The qualification limits the claim to the evidence stated in the passage.

whole_passage_checks.diagnosis: The first sentence is more certain than its stated support. The final sentence gives a useful counterexample of a bounded claim.
whole_passage_checks.question: Which outcomes are observed and which are still goals?
whole_passage_checks.think_first: Separate measured results from intentions before revising the claims.
whole_passage_checks.context_condition: Passes after every outcome claim is supported and scoped to the evidence.
